note: Opus security review records from the Mac mini checkout (Anthropic API lane, owner-approved). filesHash is tools/security-review.mjs filesHash over each ticket files list at review time; merged in #259.

findings.issue: GET / still documents boardTokenQuery (token in URL), which can leak via history or logs until T-8006 exchanges it for an HttpOnly cookie.
findings.fix: After T-8006 lands, redirect to strip t after setting the cookie, and remove boardTokenQuery.

findings.issue: Forbidden (403) is described as 'board token missing or invalid', while the descriptions say a t-query token is refused with 401; the status semantics are inconsistent.
findings.fix: Document a single status code for token failures and add the corresponding response to the /api routes.

findings.issue: The confirms Map is never swept of expired or unused tokens. Repeated prepare calls grow memory without bound.
findings.fix: Remove expired entries on each prepare and decide, and cap the number of pending confirmations per identity.

findings.issue: Prepare and decision are sent back to back in one click, so the server summary is never shown to the owner before the decision is committed.
findings.fix: Call prepare when Confirm mode is entered, show summary and expiresAt, and submit the decision on the confirm click.

findings.issue: normalizeReviewerJob treats a run-state job with no agent field as an implicit claude reviewer if its model matches. A state file missing the agent field is therefore recorded as agent claude, which the run never stated.
findings.fix: Limit the legacy fallback to test fixtures or to runs before a cutoff, or record the reviewer as 'claude (implied)' so the stored record does not claim an agent the state never listed.
